rules.name: Generative AI must route through a model gateway
rules.description: Any generative-AI pattern requires a model gateway for routing, rate limiting, spend control, and audit.
rules.message: Generative AI selected without a model gateway: no central point for safety policy, cost control, or audit.

rules.name: PII in scope requires redaction before model input
rules.description: When PII is in scope, the AI/ML layer must include PII redaction / guardrailed generation.
rules.message: PII in scope but the AI/ML layer has no redaction/guardrail pattern.

rules.name: Agentic tool access must be governed
rules.description: Any agentic pattern with tool use requires guardrailed (least-privilege, scoped) tool access.
rules.message: Agentic patterns selected without guardrailed tool access: confused-deputy and prompt-injection blast radius is unbounded.

rules.name: Production isolation with promotion-only flows
rules.description: Production workloads need environment isolation; promotion between environments must be explicit, never direct mutation.
rules.message: No governed landing-zone / managed-platform pattern: environment isolation and promotion flows are not architecturally enforced.

rules.name: Tamper-evident audit for regulated or PII workloads
rules.description: Regulated or PII-bearing workloads require a tamper-evident audit trail; the event backbone doubles as the audit source.
rules.message: Regulated workload without an event/CDC backbone to source a tamper-evident audit trail from.

rules.name: External calls restricted to approved egress
rules.description: Agentic and edge patterns that call outward must do so through approved egress with an allow-list.
rules.message: Outward-calling agentic patterns without a gateway or tool governance layer to enforce approved egress.
